definition: Model extracts a value not actually stated.
example: Extracts auto-renewal where excerpt says no renewal.

definition: Model misses a clearly stated value.
Value is too broad/narrow vs text scope.
example: Uses global cap when clause is service-specific cap.
Assigns indemnity duty to customer instead of vendor.
Omits fraud carve-out from liability cap.

definition: Fails to resolve referenced section context.
Answer not supported by cited source snippet.
Ambiguous clause should be escalated but is not.
example: Model gives definitive answer to inherently ambiguous term.
